responsibility: Declares a pedagogical channel-filter extension that inserts or removes a Caesar-cipher transformation beneath an existing IOChan channel. Its interface exposes only layer installation and removal by channel and integer key, illustrating how additional processing layers can be interposed under the gm2 generic device hooks.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the minimal public interface for the SimpleCipher module, exposing only cipher-layer insertion and removal on channels, whereas SimpleCipher.mod contains the underlying device-hook wrapping, per-channel state storage, and on-the-fly character/LOC transformation.
